summary: Organogenesis Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $75 million of Class A common stock under a sales agreement with BTIG and Citizens JMP. The stock closed at $2.37 per share on August 5, 2026. Sales are at prevailing market prices, with agent commissions up to 3.0%. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. No unusual structural features or strategic implications are present. Watch for dilution overhang, but no risk-arb angle applies.
